rows: Law, regulation, licensing, or professional rules reserve authorization to a human.
A licensed physician must sign the report.
Employer, buyer, contract, procurement rule, separation of duties, or vendor policy requires approval.
Company requires review before AI-generated code is deployed.
Human review is retained because potential harm is severe, irreversible, or requires accountable responsibility.
Clinician approves treatment; executive authorizes a large payment.
Review protects due process, fairness, confidentiality, access control, or cybersecurity.
Human reviews a benefits denial or release of medical records.
Customers or society expect a human to remain responsible for sensitive judgment or communication.
Labor agreements, skill preservation, staffing considerations, or cost calculations retain human involvement.
Union agreement preserves final employee control.
Evidence establishes a requirement, but its reason does not fit another category or cannot be determined.
Documentation requires approval without explaining why.
